title: Gravitational Time Dilation
description: A clock lower in a gravity well ticks slower than one above it. Satellite navigation has to correct for it every day, or it would drift kilometres. Unlocks the Atomic Clock.

puzzle.goal: A clock sits a distance r from the centre of a mass M. Compared with a clock far away it ticks slower. Write how many seconds τ it counts while the faraway clock counts t.
puzzle.name: Gravitational time dilation
puzzle.ask: Find τ in seconds for one hour on the surface of a neutron star: M = @{M} kg, r = 12 km (G and c in SI units).
puzzle.method: The Schwarzschild metric: for a clock at rest at radius r, dτ² = (1 − 2GM/rc²) dt².
